daily.today_energy: Your mind's moving fast today, Gemini. Channel that restless energy into something creative instead of spinning your wheels. The vibe is all about connecting dots others haven't noticed yet.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your wit right now. Whether you're single or taken, your communication game is hitting different today. Say the thing you've been sitting on—honesty hits harder than you think.
daily.career: This is a solid day for pitching ideas or having those conversations you've been putting off. Your natural curiosity is your superpower rn. Trust that instinct to explore new angles on old projects.
